post.summary: Delete all data back to a fresh install and replace the decryption key (D-154). Needs the exact organization name (400 confirm_mismatch), the current password (400 wrong_password, counted like a failed sign-in, 429 rate_limited) and, when two-step sign-in is on, a fresh code (400 code_required / invalid_code). 409 busy while a host run, an update or another purge runs; 502 host_unreachable when the configured helper does not answer, its socket missing included (nothing is deleted); 412 transition_pending; 500 backups_already_deleted when the purge fails after the helper deleted its backups (the data on the box is still there). kept lists what was not done or not touched (host_backups: this box is configured without a helper, so there were no helper backups to delete; honeypot_log: the raw log of the honeypot belongs to its container and stays; key_not_replaced: the new key could not be written, replace vedette.key by hand)

Restore a backup kept on this box (D-377): core first takes a copy of the current data, kept as a pre_restore backup, and the helper puts it back by itself when the restored data does not start. 409 confirm_required without confirm_data_loss: true; 404 backup_unknown; then the current password (400 wrong_password, counted like a failed sign-in, 429 rate_limited) and, when two-step sign-in is on, a fresh code (400 code_required / invalid_code), as for the purge; 409 busy, low_disk, schema_newer, not_appliance; 412 secrets_missing; 502 checksum_mismatch

After those checks the Vulnerability scans module does the scan (D-229, D-57 (7)): ports are scanned only on the box's own verified public IPs; a domain's names from certificate transparency are listed and get one GET of / by name on ports 80 and 443. 409 module_off while that module is off; 409 busy while another scan runs on the box; 429 rate_limited within 10 minutes of the target's last scan; 400 too_many when the domain has more than 300 names in the logs; 502 unreachable when the certificate-transparency search (crt.sh) does not answer or the scan does not finish within 5 minutes. Nothing is saved then; every attempt is audited
